Its primary purpose is to process and mutate inference request/response payloads via a pluggable IPP (Inference Payload Processor) framework. It contains a rich set of payload processing plugins (api-translation, apikey-injection, external-metering, model-provider-resolver, nemo, stream-usage-enforcer, etc.) that perform custom request/response mutations of headers and body. While it does include Kubernetes controllers and CRDs (ExternalModel, ExternalProvider) via controller-runtime, these serve as the configuration mechanism for the service — they watch for custom resources that define how models map to providers and configure the plugin pipeline accordingly. The service itself is deployed alongside an Istio/Envoy gateway and processes live traffic, making it fundamentally a data-path service rather than a lifecycle-managing operator.
